displayName: Block users from configuring credentials (work profile-level)
description: If 'True', prevents users from configuring certificates assigned to devices, even devices that aren't associated with a user account. If 'False', Intune doesn't change or update this setting. By default, the OS might make it possible for users to configure or change their credentials when they access them in the keystore. Available for fully managed, dedicated and corporate-owned work profile devices (at work profile level).
